notes.title: [Policy on Multi Client]
notes.content:
Dear SOF Community,

We hope this message finds you well. 
We are writing to inform you about an important update to our policy regarding Multi-Client usage in Scions of Fate, aimed at enhancing your gaming experience.

● Basic Policy:

The core policy remains unchanged. A pop-up message will still appear when attempting to open more than the allowed number of clients.

• IP: Maximum of 5 clients
• PC: Maximum of 2 clients

This policy is in place to prevent potential issues related to account spamming, abuse, or hacking incidents. 
We appreciate your understanding in this matter.

Similar to our handling of VPN usage, which is categorized as an unsupported issue, Multi-Client usage will be treated in the same manner.

● Policy Changes:

Previously, exceeding the allowed number of clients resulted in automatic penalties. However, based on player feedback, we understand that this has caused difficulties, especially for those engaging in party play. Therefore, we will no longer penalize players for using Multi-Client as long as it does not negatively impact the game environment.

● Important Notes:

• We strongly discourage the use of third-party programs or bypassing internet restrictions, as these actions can lead to negative consequences.
• If a player creates multiple accounts to exploit the game system or abuses game mechanics, we will ban the account and IP address.
 
Please note that issues arising from the use of Multi-Client may be classified as "unsupportable issues."

● Exceptions:

While we will not actively sanction Multi-Client usage, if this allowance is abused (e.g., excessive client usage or monopolizing hunting grounds), players will face penalties.

● For Players Previously Banned:

If you were banned for Multi-Client issues, please submit a ticket. We will investigate and unban accounts that did not cause harm or violate rules. This does not guarantee an automatic unban.

We hope these changes will enhance your gaming experience. Thank you for being a valued member of our community.

Please note that this policy is subject to change.

Sincerely, 
SOF Team

notes.title: [Notice] About [Bugs]Natural Low Grade Soul Stone
notes.content:
Dear SOF Community!

We got feedback that due to the [Bug] Natural Low Grade Soul Stone item, 
players are experiencing inconvenience in using the item through the 
'Exchange of Unserviceable Event Item' quest.

Therefore, to address the issue where the [Bug] Natural Low Grade Soul Stone 
disappears without any effect when used, we plan to change this bugged item to a regular item 
and skip the process of changing it to Low Grade Soul Stone (Natural).

As result, after the maintenance on 12/06/2023, 
the quest 'Exchange of Unserviceable Event Item' will be removed from NPC Woody's quest list, 
and the [Bugs] Natural Low Grade Soul Stone item will be changed to Low Grade Soul Stone (Natural).
Additionally, an abnormal success rate has been identified, promoting a slight adjustment accordingly.

Thus, players who wish to exchange items through the quest are recommended to exchange 
all [Bugs] Natural Low Grade Soul Stone items through Woody's quest before 12/06/2023 at 18:00 PM (PST).

※Note!
- The quest 'Exchange of Unserviceable Event Item' will be removed after the 12/06/2023 maintenance.
- After the 12/06/2023 maintenance, [Bugs] Natural Grade Soul Stone will be changed to Low Grade Soul Stone (Natural).
- After the 12/06/2023 maintenance, an abnormal enhancement success rate will be slightly adjusted.

Best Regards,
SOF Team

notes.title: Announcement
notes.content:
[Reminder] 

We're informing the current events surrounding Netgame, Inc. 
Netgame has been part of a global company called “SmartBig Corp.”. 
The stakeholder of Netgame, Inc. has been SmartBig Cooperation since the start and till now. 
By law starting from July 1st, 2022, we have to label any documentation or 
legal-wise content with our stakeholder’s name “Smart-Big Cooperation”. 
Due to this action, we have to notify and also need users to renew their User Agreement. 
This may be burdening and may cause a hassle.
Bt please take your time renewing your user policy agreements with us. 
Listed below are the highlights and summaries please read it carefully to 
fully understand the closure of this situation.
 
1. Everyone who logs in from July 1st should acknowledge and 
accept alternation of the Terms of Agreement of Netgame Inc. 
This is to continue participating and being part of Netgame’s games and agreeing to the policy 
regarding the product of his/her account to the Netgame service in North America. 
Starting from 25nd of July 2022, Updated User Agreement & Privacy Policy 
will be up as a pop-up window once you log into your account via the official website.
We encourage you to review the changes in the User Agreement and Privacy Policy and 
want you to make sure to confirm these changes as soon as possible. 
Please be informed that, as of 16th of August, those who have not confirmed/accepted 
the updated version of User Agreement and Privacy Policy, 
account status will be changed to “PENDING”. Account reactivation process is to simply accept the changes in policy on the official website. We highly recommend that you proceed with agreeing 
to the change in policy in advance to avoid account inactivation issue. 
 
2. Any contents with reference to your items, cash, and contents will be untouched. 
Any cash / Ingame gold / Game Items will not be needed to be transferred due to no alteration happening regarding games and publishing.
 
3. All the current staff / same publisher will remain the same. 
We are still Netgame however have to label documentation in our Stakeholder’s name 
“SmartBig Corp.” due to legal reasons. Just note that SmartBig was our major stakeholder 
since the opening of Netgame Inc.

4. Lastly if the Privacy Policy / User Agreement has not been accepted aforementioned your account will go to ‘Pending Status’. If you do not finish the agreement by logging in to our website and accepting it, your account will not be able to enter our games from August 16th 2022 until accepted. Please complete this your account restrained from connecting into our games.
We thank you for your loyalty to Netgame. Again, nothing will be changed except that the labelings 
of names presented in documentation and website have to be presented as “SmartBig”. 
We appreciate your endorsement of us and we shall proceed to becoming a better and 
progressing company.

Thanks & Best Regards from all Netgame Staff.


 Announcement

notes.title: [Notice] DD and Party-time Event Renewal
notes.content:
[Notice] DD and Party-time Event Renewal

Dear SOF Community!

We had opened a Forum to hear feedback from our valuable players for an issue of 
"DD and Party-time event" last month. 

After a continuous argument and discussion with our team, the Dev team insist on
 closing DD and PTE event, but long story short, we decided to continue providing DD and PTE events.
However, for many reasons - new content update and holding various events in the future 
- reducing the percentage of the events will be inevitable.

The new version of the DD & PTE event will start on August 1st.

a) Weekend DD Event
-  Before: Every Weekend
- After: Once a month > SOF Weekend (Last weekend of the month)

b) PTE Event
- After: Percentage will be reduced compared before

Once again, thank you all for sharing small and big suggestions, ideas, and feedback with our team.
We will be bringing new content, events soon and hope it could satisfy our players. If you have more feedback good or bad, please feel free to share with us.

We much appreciate your support.

Sincerely,
SOF Team

notes.content:
Dear, SOF

Recently, we are receiving ticketes that certain players are spreading false information on SOF staffs again.

Since this activity can result in a negative influence on SOF community, we would like to inform players that

[olist]
 GMs do not ban a player without clear evidence.

Players will receive items from GMs ONLY when there is:

 rollback due to system error
 hacking/scamming incident


Please be aware that Netgame highly suggests players avoid following activities as it can lead to penalties.




 17. Members may not Engage in any "disruptive behavior" that is deemed to
include, but is not limited to, conduct that purposely interferes with the normal
 flow of game-play or interferes with the usage of other Members use and their
 enjoyment the Games.
 
 ii) Behavior: Behavior that intentionally detracts from others' enjoyment (such
 as harassment, Insulting Netgame image, racism, insults, sexual verbal insult
 etc.) is unacceptable. We expect our players to treat each other with respect,
 and promote an enjoyable environment. Acceptable behavior is determined
 by player reports and Netgame's decision, and violating these guidelines will
 result in the account and gameplay restrictions.
 
 vii) False report: While we encourage you to report players that are behaving in a disrespectful manner, falsely eporting another player with the sole intent of restricting their gameplay is also unacceptable and will result in penalties to your account.
 
 viii) Spamming: Spamming can lead to penalties.
 (REFUSING TO ACCEPT MANAGEMENT JUDGEMENT, SENDING TICKETS
 OVER AND OVER AGAIN, ETC)

that include rumors on GM without enough evidence. Tickets can be closed without notice.

New item, "Hunting Flag" will be added.
Enough worries for KSing! Now mark your own hunting area by using the flag🚩🚩🚩

- Name of the item : Summoning Charm of Hunting Flag
- Item Description : Summoning Charm of Hunting Flag that can preoccupy hunting spot. Use the item at the area where you want to occupy in advance. (Can be used by characters over level 60)

- Name of the item : Summoning Charm of Hunting Flag(10)
- Item Description : Summoning Charm of Hunting Flag that can preoccupy hunting  spot. Use the item at the area where you want to occupy in advance. (Can be used by characters over level 60)(10 times available)                             [Selling items to NPC is not allowed] 

a) Effects of the Fag
It will be able to preoccupy hunting area by using the hunting flag from now on.

※ Please be aware that :
- Area markers - player who used the flag and his paty members- can hunt freely in their area when other characters hits a monster in the flag area monsters will not be affected and "Attack Failure" applies. (Southern Forest Medicine, debuff, etc included)
- Items that are consumed by other in the other players' flag area, it will be consumed with the attack failure.
- Field bosses are not affected by the Flag area.

b) How to use the Flag
[olist]
 Summoning Charm of Hunting Flag can be purchaseed from NPC shop with gold.
     NPC : The Eight Trigrams Old Man
     Price : Summoning Charm of Hunting Flag       1,000,000 Gold
                Summoning Charm of Hunting Flag(10) 10,000,000 Gold

 Move to the place you wish to hunt and use the item.
 When using the item, an area display flag will be created at the character position and the effect coverage will be displayed. (If the party member uses the item in the same area, the number of the flag will be increased.)
[/olist]

[table]
[tr]
[td]
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/e94e232a50315ee0a7f73c8d88500830fe477ea1.png

                Other's area - Green
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

c) Cancellation of the Area                        
The flag area will be cancelled when :
- Character moves out of the flag area for 20 seconds.
  (In addition to simple movement, this applies to all regional movements such as regression, return, and wedding rings.) 
  (If multiple party members have used flag in the same place, only the flag of the character moving outside the zone will be released.)
- Character dies. (If multiple party members have used flag in the same place, only the dead character's flag area will be released)
- Character is occupying flag area and made a new party.
- If a member of the party withdraws, only the banned party member's flag 
  will be released. (Party banishment included)
- If the party is disbanded, all zone flags that the party members have had 
  will be destroyed.

d) More about the Flag
- There is no expiration time for the zone indication flag.
- Flag can be used by characters over level 60 and only one per character.
- It can't be used in the following situations : 
[olist]
   If there is an opponent's character other than yourself and your party members 
       in the area.
   When the area is overlapped
   Outside the Hunting area (PVP, Dungeon)
   If you already have occupied an area
[/olist]
- When a monster summoned outside the area enters the area, it will be affected by the Flag and vice versa, when a monster summoned inside the area leaves the zone, it will not be affected by the flag.
- Hunting Flag can be used for each character even if you are in a party.
[olist]
   Flags can't be used if the area is overlapped

notes.title: [Announcement] False Report Issue
notes.content:
Dear SOF Community!

Recently, we are receiving tickets that certain players are spreading false 
information on SOF staffs. 

Since this activity can result in a negative influence on SOF community,

we would like to inform players that

1. GMs do not ban a player without clear evidence.
2. GMs do not give items to players for personal benefit.
    Players will receive items from GMs ONLY when there is :
     - rollback due to system error
     - hacking/scamming incident

Please be aware that Netgame highly suggests players avoid 
following activities as it can lead to penalties. 

17. Members may not Engage in any disruptive behavior that is deemed to include, but is not limited to, conduct that purposely interferes with the normal flow of game-play or interferes with the usage of other Members use and their enjoyment the Games.

ii) Behavior: Behavior that intentionally detracts from others' enjoyment (such as harassment, Insulting Netgame image, racism, insults, sexual verbal insult etc.) is unacceptable. We expect our players to treat each other with respect, and promote an enjoyable environment. Acceptable behavior is determined by player reports and Netgame's decision, and violating these guidelines will result in the account and gameplay restrictions.

vii) False report: While we encourage you to report players that are behaving in a disrespectful manner, falsely reporting another player with the sole intent of restricting their gameplay is also unacceptable and will result in penalties to your account.

viii) Spamming: Spamming can lead to penalties. (REFUSING TO ACCEPT MANAGEMENT JUDGEMENT, SENDING TICKETS 
OVER AND OVER AGAIN, ETC)

In addition, to manage tickets with efficiency GMs will not respond to tickets 
that include rumors on GM without enough evidence. Tickets can be closed 
without notice.

Regards
Wingback

notes.title: [Notice] Authority Clash Abusing Issue
notes.content:
Dear SOF community !

Recently, we are receiving a large number of tickets regarding
players showing abusing activities in Authority Clash.

After carefully investigating the issue, we have confirmed
that few of the players have been advantaged by  "abusing" 
the system which is considered "unfair".

Please be aware that Netgame does not allow foul activities
as below:

i) Cheating: You are responsible for how you and 
your account are represented in the game. 
Cheating in any way will result in immediate action.

Using third-party programs to automate any aspect 
of the game, exploiting bugs, or 

engaging in any activity that grants an unfair 
advantage is considered cheating. 

Exploiting other players is an equally serious offense. 
Scamming, account sharing, and anything else that 
may degrade the gaming experience for other players 
will receive appropriate penalties. 

Thus, this is a warning notice to players that If a player 
who is found showing suspicious activity including abusing 
in-game (logging into 2 different accounts which are order/chaos 
and kill each other in order to fraud score and earn points unfairly), 
we will ban all the related accounts and IP address from 9/03.

When showing the abusing activity, a player will be banned
at least for a week. However, if the player repeatedly shows
the action, he/she will be permanently be banned.

If you have any questions or information regarding this issue,
please do not hesitate to share it with us.

Regards
Wingback

notes.title: [Notice] DamHwaLyn Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello, SOF Community!


Finally, after months of waiting, new character “DamHwaLyn” has arrived! 

Much appreciate SOF players for waiting her.

“DamHwaLyn” is the main female character of Scions of Fate 
and a best friend of Hanbia, using “Death Flower Leaf Sword”. 
This character shows better evasion than the Sword.

Now, let’s find out more about her😊

Create Character

We should create “DamHwaLyn” character in advance.
Log in to our server and create DamHwaLyn.

▼ In the beginning, DamHwaLyn’s stat will be ideal to the sword-class character.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/cfb5c07ee4c47d75abf07c2121b54c6138fe414d.png

▼ Give your character a name and get ready to start!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/85ab4493d8d6f61cbea8ee59b1079dc45152680d.png

Weapon (Death Flower Leaf Sword)

Hero class Damhwalyn will only be using its own weapon, 
“Death Flower Leaf Sword” just like Hanbia character.

Please keep in mind that exchanging, selling or discarding 
“Death Flower Leaf Sword” will not be allowed. 

After character promotions, you will be able to upgrade the weapon 
through completing its own quests and the quests can be received from NPC Chan.

Whenever it levels up, “Death Flower Leaf Sword” will change its appearance 
and increase its attack rate. However, it has special enhance conditions to level up.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/6a507808f2adf1a00a018655d45adb3e5d65edaf.png

The item, “Heavenly Protection Pill” can be obtained by completing the Quest, 
“King Mandock Heavenly Protection Pill(HanBiGwang)” from NPC GunWoo from Southern Forest.

▼ Death Flower Leaf Sword(8th) (True) 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/7befdd0988e5fc81947bc5463ea875abaaf6a594.png

Skill

Players can learn skills and make it stronger when the character levels up.
However, if you haven’t mastered the first skill, the following skills 
will not be able to be learned. In particular, Damhwalyn can register combo 
at the bottom of the Skill Window like below: 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/89f30a516fdd9187475b697ddcb5bf145225e4c2.png

Combo activates by certain percentages while hunting monsters.
For “ALL KILL”, simply press the activated comments in order 
and you’ll get much Exp and gold!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/b4b0e7e8a67f6ddb084350050facaf2ae7c84239.png

Ability

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/4aed2ccf38ed40b93add477937657475f2c3c445.png

Promotion

Promotion for Damhwalyn will be different from usual promotion system on SOF.
Players can meet characters from the original cartoon-like Hanbia character does.

Promotion quests for Damhwalyn are available at “Space-Time Gate”.
( Except 2nd and 3rd promotion quests.)

“Space-Time Gate” is located near NPC Sky Ryu in Central Valley. 
Players can easily find the place by simply clicking the red dot, “Space-Time Gate”.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/2b2597a3707420ce3e70bfdec9859a68daf045ac.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/8562dfc1e0715478c6c0234dc80fdd9ee5a5cbdf.png

※ Last notice!

Please be aware that the items below will not be able to use in-game.

a. Training Marble[Nidana]
b. Forgotten Title Abstract(weapon) / Forgotten Title Abstract(Cloth)
c. Glorious Title Abstract(Cloth) / Glorious Title Abstract(weapon) 

Thank you very much for reading the notice 
and once again much appreciate SOF players patience on this update. 

As always, we will do our best to make SOF better environment.

If you have any questions or problems regarding new update, 
please don’t hesitate to send us tickets. 

We look forward to hearing feedbacks or questions from players😊

▷  Dan Hwa Lyn Preview 


Best Regards
SOF Team
